description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Patron of the Arts, adding {C}{C}.
Patron of the Arts dies, triggering itself and Enduring Renewal.
Resolve the Patron of the Arts trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Patron of the Arts by paying {2}{R}.
Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.
